meta.name: game-analytics-setup
meta.description: Invoke when the user needs to set up analytics, define telemetry events, establish KPIs, build dashboards, configure A/B testing, or implement data-driven design capabilities. Triggers on: "analytics", "telemetry", "KPIs", "metrics", "player data", "retention", "DAU", "dashboard", "A/B testing", "funnel analysis". Do NOT invoke for balance tuning (use game-balance-check) or economy design (use game-economy-designer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为游戏设置数据追踪与分析看板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为游戏配置埋点、指标和可视化分析
copy.tagline_en: Set up game analytics and dashboards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure telemetry, KPIs, and dashboards for your game

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演游戏分析负责人 Renzo Ikeda，帮你设计事件分类、定义 KPI、搭建仪表盘、配置 A/B 测试，并确保数据隐私合规。
howto.when: 当你提到“分析”、“事件”、“KPI”、“留存”、“仪表盘”、“A/B 测试”等关键词，或需要设置游戏数据分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计新手教程的留存 KPI 和事件。
say.note: Claude 会给出 D1/D7 留存定义和教程完成事件。

say.text: 我想为游戏搭建一个每日运营仪表盘。
say.note: Claude 会列出 DAU、崩溃率、收入等指标。

say.text: 如何设计一个 A/B 测试来优化商店定价？
say.note: Claude 会说明样本量、运行时长和注意事项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as analytics lead Renzo Ikeda, helping you design event taxonomy, define KPIs, build dashboards, configure A/B testing, and ensure privacy compliance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "analytics", "telemetry", "KPIs", "retention", "dashboard", "A/B testing", or need to set up game analytics.

say_en.text: Help me design retention KPIs and events for the tutorial.
say_en.note: Claude will define D1/D7 retention and tutorial completion events.

say_en.text: I want to build a daily operations dashboard for my game.
say_en.note: Claude will list DAU, crash rate, revenue, etc.

say_en.text: How to design an A/B test for shop pricing?
say_en.note: Claude explains sample size, duration, and pitfalls.
